caption: The drawing shows a long, full skirt with a visible waistband that is rendered in a muted blue-green color palette with black outlines. The main portion of the skirt features a repeating diamond lattice pattern. Along the lower section of the skirt, there is a wide decorative border with an ornate floral design, including large stylized leaves and flower motifs. Attached to the waistband are visible button details, and a thin ribbon or tie is depicted at the center. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a rectangular inset showing an enlarged detail of the skirt’s fabric pattern, highlighting the combination of the diamond lattice and floral motif, and rendered in similar blue-green tones with fine linework. The background is plain and uncolored.
